rule: Each row runs one stage on a w×h image whose every texel is `in` (or `inImage`, row-major RGBA) and expects `out` everywhere (or `outImage`). space = straight: colours are straight alpha; premultiplied: RGB already multiplied by alpha. Layer-box stages (vignette, mask) use texel centres u = (x + 0.5)/w, v = (y + 0.5)/h; canvasMask and place use canvas px (x + 0.5, y + 0.5). tol is the CPU tolerance; GPU implementations use the ARCH §11.6 parity tolerance.
